tools.name: sol_networks
tools.description: List Solana networks this API builds for (mainnet-beta, devnet), the on-chain programs used, and the exact rent + fee table for a token launch in lamports. Free — no payment required.

tools.name: sol_launch_plan
tools.description: Free. Validate a Solana token launch before building it: normalises name/symbol/supply/decimals, applies a typed allow/review/deny gate, states the authority policy (mint revoked, no freeze authority by default) and returns the exact on-chain cost in SOL and USD. Use this first — it costs nothing an

tools.name: sol_token_audit
tools.description: $0.003 per call. Read a Solana SPL mint's real authority state: who can mint more supply, who can freeze holders, whether the metadata is immutable, plus on-chain name/symbol/logo and a verdict with machine-readable flags. Reads the chain directly — no opinion, no blacklist.

tools.name: sol_build_launch_tx
tools.description: $0.02 per call. Returns a complete, unsigned Solana transaction that creates an SPL mint, writes Metaplex metadata on-chain, mints the supply to the payer and revokes the mint authority in the same transaction. NON-CUSTODIAL: the service never sees a private key — the caller signs with their own wal

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "sol_build_launch_tx" references sensitive artifacts (private key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
